text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're looking pretty miserable. Did you
goof
something up again?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've been trying so hard not to,
but it
never seems to work...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to say this for a while, but
can't you
think through your problems
logically?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If we identify the nature of your
blunders and
then run the numbers, we
should be able to come
up with a fix.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, really? Well... let's see what
goof-ups I did
recently...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I fumbled with the seasonings when I was cooking and spilled all of them into the pot...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
An insufficient static friction
coefficient—put a
non-slip pad under
everything.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I slipped on a banana peel, and then as
soon as I
got up, I slipped on the same
peel again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a continuity problem. Find the
pattern and
you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And one time during class, I was trying
to pick up
a pen I dropped, but I fell
down and took the
whole desk with me...
Even the chair fell over on
my head...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... I don't think my calculations can account for that one. I'll have to reevaluate the magnitude of the goof-up factor...
